messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Installing previous versions of aroma.affymetrix
parts:
Hi,

since there are some problems with the aroma.affymetrix v0.4.4-v0.4.6,
you might want to roll back to a previous version that you know worked
for you. You can do this by:

source("http://www.braju.com/R/hbLite.R")

hbGet("aroma.affymetrix", "0.4.4", "tar.gz") # Source
hbGet("aroma.affymetrix", "0.4.4", "zip") # If on Windows

and then install either of the downloaded version by:

install.packages("aroma.affymetrix_0.4.4.tar.gz", repos=NULL)
install.packages("aroma.affymetrix_0.4.4.zip", repos=NULL)

FYI, I've updated the group page on "Installtion and updates" to
explain this too.

Sorry about the recent mess. I'm working on figuring out what causes
it. Feedback is valuable and helps finding the bug(s) so please keep
sending them.

Henrik
